summary: CECO Environmental Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Thermon Group Holdings, Inc. via a two-step merger structure. CECO, through its merger subsidiaries, acquired Thermon, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary ultimately merged into Merger Sub LLC, renamed Thermon Group Holdings, LLC. The filing does not disclose the price per share, total consideration, or premium, but confirms the closing occurred on June 1, 2026, as previously announced. No board recommendations or advisors are named. This is a completed special-situation acquisition; watch for post-close integration updates and any related financing details.
